text:
sam: quick note from today's console pass: the new status pills in the model list aren't announced as "selected" by VoiceOver. they show a blue outline visually but no ARIA state.
amira: repro'd on macOS — VO reads the pill label but not the toggle/selected state. aria-current or aria-pressed would help depending on semantics.
kevin_l: semantics question: are pills single-select (one active) or multi-toggle? current UX allows multiple filters on, so aria-pressed makes sense (toggle buttons).
dina: also spotted a contrast problem: selected pill text is #0C3A66 on #DFF2FF which measures ~3.4:1 for normal text. need >=4.5:1 unless we move to larger text.
aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan (model-list-pills-2598765432): failures: 2 (missing aria-pressed, low contrast for selected text). report: https://ci.internal/a11y/2598765432
sam: small fix proposal:
- change pills to role="button" aria-pressed="true|false"
- ensure keyboard space/enter toggles pressed state and calls event.preventDefault()
- bump selected text color to #05264D (est contrast 4.7:1)
- add focus-visible outline: 3px solid #0B3B82
amira: quick keyboard repro steps I used:
```
1) Open Console -> Models
2) Tab to pills area
3) Press Space on a pill
4) Observe VoiceOver announcement (should say "{label}, button, pressed")
```
kevin_l: implementation nit: our pill component currently sets tabindex=0 on each pill. for toggle buttons that's fine but we should also manage role and aria-pressed consistently. I'll add a unit test to assert aria-pressed flips on Space/Enter.
dina: also add an aria-live polite region that announces filter count: "Filters applied: 2" when any pill toggles. VO sometimes doesn't announce state changes for aria-pressed unless there's a live update context.
sam: agree. aria-live is helpful for summary updates but screen readers should still get the local state via aria-pressed.
kevin_l: code snippet I'll push:
```
<button role="button" class="pill" aria-pressed="false" tabindex="0">
  Active
</button>
```
and handler:
```
pill.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault()
    togglePill(pill)
  }
})
```
dina: acceptance criteria for INS-12021:
- VoiceOver/NVDA announce pill label + "button" + "pressed" when toggled
- focus ring visible at 2x zoom on macOS and Windows
- selected text contrast >= 4.5:1
- aria-live summary updates filter count after change
aria-bot: created INS-12021, linked scan, priority P3, assignee @kevin_l, ETA 3d.
sam: tiny copy tweak: change pill tooltip from "on"/"off" to "enabled"/"disabled" — reads better in some screen readers.
amira: good catch. also add role description via aria-describedby that points to a short helper: "Toggle filter on or off" for first-time users.
kevin_l: will push PR with aria-pressed, aria-live, CSS color update, and tests. ping here when ready for review.
dina: please include NVDA + VoiceOver short audio clip if anything reads weird after the patch. thanks.
aria-bot: INS-12021 branch pushed; a11y-e2e queued.
sam: thanks team. closing thread, will follow up in the ticket. :thumbsup:"
